texts.li: [!child] {X_nameDef}, who travels with the gift, lit {A_nameDef}'s pipe with a snap of {X_possessive} fingers and then, seeing {A_possessive} face, did it again more slowly.
"Show me something," {A_nameDef} said. "Anything." {X_nameDef} made the dust on the floor rise and wheel like a flock of birds, then let it settle in a ring around {A_possessive} boots.
[x:healer] {X_nameDef} noticed {A_nameDef} favoring one hand and closed the old cut on it with a touch, as if it were nothing.
[child] {X_nameDef} made a small light hop from finger to finger for {A_nameDef}, then let {A_objective} hold it. It felt like a warm pebble.
[night] Long after supper, {X_nameDef} drew pictures in the smoke for {A_nameDef}: a ship, a tower, a face {X_pronoun} didn't name.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} recognized the gift in each other across the yard, and spent the evening comparing workings like two cooks comparing knives.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {X_possessive} school gathers power, which is backwards from how {A_nameDef} was taught and, annoyingly, works.
{A_nameDef} traded {X_nameDef} a minor working for one of {X_possessive}, and spent the rest of the evening getting the new one wrong in the yard.
[x:healer] {X_nameDef} is a healer first and a mage second, and talked with {A_nameDef} until late about what a body will let you mend.
{X_nameDef}, who fights for a living, watched {A_nameDef} train in the yard and then, without a word, moved {A_possessive} back foot a hand's width to the left. It helped.
"How did you get so quick?" {A_nameDef} asked. Ten thousand mornings, {X_nameDef} said, and showed {A_objective} the first one.
{X_nameDef} walked {A_nameDef} through an old form with empty hands, slow as a dance, until {A_nameDef} could do it with {A_possessive} eyes shut.
